summary: Backend-only testing of monthly calculation fix in GET /api/dashboard/monthly-chart (6 months) and GET /api/dashboard/financiero evolucion_mensual (12 months). All 10 tests passed. Verified: exact month count, chronological order oldest->newest, consecutive months without skips, unique month names, cross-year boundary handling (Jan 2026 backward crosses into 2025).
critical_code_review_comments: monthly-chart response model MonthlyChartItem only exposes short month name (e.g. 'Jan') without year - if the 6-month window ever spans >12 months names would collide; currently safe since window is 6 months. Consider including year for clarity.

In dashboard_financiero.py the current-month range uses mes_fin=now.day; if aggregation runs before today's data is stored it's fine, but ensure timezone consistency (uses UTC while data may be stored as local ISO strings).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Test file test_monthly_calc_fix.py validates monthly loop calculation correctness for both dashboard endpoints. Requires REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL env var. Uses _expected_months helper to compute the expected chronological YYYY-MM keys.
rca of the issue: N/A - fix verified working. The previous timedelta(days=30*i) approach could skip months on leap years / 31-day months; new arithmetic (target_month = current_month - i, adjusting year when <=0) produces exactly the expected consecutive months confirmed by tests.
